This is an [R Markdown](http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com) Notebook. When you execute code within the notebook, the results appear beneath the code. 

Try executing this chunk by clicking the *Run* button within the chunk or by placing your cursor inside it and pressing *Cmd+Shift+Enter*. 

```{r}

library(RevGadgets)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtree)

setwd("~/Repos/Palicourea/Inflorescence_ASE)

CHARACTER <- "palicourea.inflorescence_type"
NUM_STATES <- 4

STATE_LABELS <- c("0" = "Palicourea-like", "1" = "Cephaelis-like", "2" = "Open Psychotria-like", "3" = "Condensed Psychotria-like")

tree_file <- paste0(CHARACTER,"_ase_freeK.tree")

#install.packages("ggtree")
# process the ancestral states
ase <- processAncStates(tree_file,
                        # Specify state labels.
                        # These numbers correspond to
                        # your input data file.
                        state_labels = STATE_LABELS)
state_cols <- c(
  "Palicourea-like" = "#2C6BB2",
  "Cephaelis-like" = "#2CB1B5",
  "Open Psychotria-like" = "#B21E4B",
  "Condensed Psychotria-like" = "#F07F5A"
)

# produce the plot object, showing MAP states at nodes.
# color corresponds to state, size to the state's posterior probability
p <- plotAncStatesMAP(t = ase,
                      tree_layout = "rect",
                      tip_labels_size = 1) +
     # modify legend location using ggplot2
     theme(legend.position = c(0.92,0.81))

#p <- plotAncStatesMAP(t = ase,
 #                     tree_layout = "rect",
  #                    tip_labels_size = 1) +
  #   scale_color_manual(values = state_cols) +
  #   theme(legend.position = c(0.92,0.81))

ggsave(paste0(CHARACTER,"_ASE_FreeK_MAP.pdf"), p, width = 11, height = 15)


p <- plotAncStatesPie(t = ase,
                      tree_layout = "rect",
                      tip_labels_size = 1) +
     # modify legend location using ggplot2
     theme(legend.position = c(0.92,0.81))

#p <- plotAncStatesPie(t = ase,
 #                     tree_layout = "rect",
  #                    tip_labels_size = 1) +
   #  scale_fill_manual(values = state_cols) +
    # theme(legend.position = c(0.92,0.81))

ggsave(paste0(CHARACTER,"_ASE_FreeK_Pie.pdf"), p, width = 11, height = 15)
```
